experiments.dataset: EVAL-SET-001 v1 (authored 2026-10-06, not an external sample)
experiments.environment: i7-870 CPU, 16GB RAM, torch 2.14.1+cpu, transformers (pip), seed 1337
experiments.failure_analysis: One-shot post-training quantization without calibration/retraining collapses quality at <=4 bits on this model (CE 25-211 vs 4.73 baseline). INT8 dynamic degrades 4.6x AND is slower with more RAM. Residuals at 1% cost more bytes than they recover. Early-exit routing works mechanically (87.5/12.5) but the untrained fast path is miscalibrated.
experiments.hypothesis: Compact representation + elastic compute can preserve behavior at far below fp32 cost; one-shot methods fail without retraining
